metadata.case_name: FAN SHUIT LUI v. SHING WAH CHAI AND ANOTHER

source: The Plaintiff was struck from the left; he suffered fractures of 2 ribs, of the pelvis in four places, and whilst these fractures have united the right pelvis is rotated slightly, and he has a½ inch shortening of the right leg and limitation of the left hip joint movement.

injuries.description: Fractures of the pelvis in four places; right pelvis rotated slightly; 1/2 inch shortening of the right leg
